detector._note: Keypoints 23-25-27 / 24-26-28 (hip-knee-ankle), 3D world angle. Standing is 180 in theory; a locked knee reads 165-178 on the world landmarks, so TOP is >=165. The bottom is 100-70 (BOTTOM at <=100), 85 is full depth.

stage._note: fitmon countSquats: both knees <110 is down, both >160 counts on the way back up, 1000 ms. Ceiling 185: A knee does not extend past about 180. Counting happens standing up, where there is no such thing as too straight, so this only refuses a reading a knee cannot make. A ceiling makes the rep a whole cycle: it lands when the movement returns to rest, not when it first crosses the line, so a half rep cannot count.

tempo._note: measured window: topExit crossing -> bottomEnter crossing, not the full descent

cues.tooHigh: Sit deeper — knees to 100° or less.
cues.framing: I can't see your knees — step back.
